justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: STEADI translates evidence-based fall prevention into clinical workflow; population-level fall reduction supported.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: Free online training modules; approximately 1-2 hours; no cost; immediate access; zero barrier.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to any clinician treating older adults; fall risk tools usable in outpatient, home health, and primary care.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: STEADI tools referenced in CMS fall prevention quality measures; supports documentation for Medicare fall risk billing codes.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Valued in geriatric programs and quality improvement roles; not commonly listed as required in job postings.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Systematic screening normalizes fall risk conversation; patients appreciate structured approach.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Older adults rarely pay cash for falls screening; reimbursed through Medicare wellness, not cash.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Free toolkit; zero scarcity, no pricing power.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Public-domain framework anyone can use; no defensibility.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Could anchor a community-falls program staff can deliver, but margins are thin.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Consumers don't search for 'STEADI'; they search for balance/falls help.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Useful curricular content but not a recognized credential for hiring/promotion.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Anchors a real geriatrics research literature on screening and outcomes.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Directly maps to geriatrics, community health, and population-health course content.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Reasonable evidence for screening; intervention effect sizes more modest.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Not typically listed as preferred; GCS carries more weight.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Free and fast; high ROI for curriculum building.
